waves.reason: Establish the first production-quality, persistent, mobile-first gameplay slice and stable domain/persistence interfaces.
Fleet management and harbour gameplay can progress in parallel after the shared voyage/company interfaces exist.
Map depends on fleet state; ship market/maintenance depends on stable fleet/company transactions.
Financing and deeper markets both build on the ship/economy model and can be implemented independently.
Era progression should be layered onto a functioning fleet, financing, and market game.
